notes: Additive combo registry. NEVER modifies combo_brackets_v1.json (Spellbook canonical). Sources: hand-curated seed list (v1.0); EDHRec / cEDH-decklist-database extractors planned for iter 6. Each entry has source attribution + bracket classification + a one-sentence outcome. Merge policy: Spellbook entry takes precedence on bracket conflicts.

discovered.outcome: Curiosity on Niv-Mizzet: each cantrip Niv-Mizzet pings draws a card, looping until each opponent dies.
Sanguine Bond turns life gain into opponent life loss; Exquisite Blood turns opponent life loss into your life gain. Trigger either to win.
Heliod gives Ballista lifelink. Pay 1 to add a counter; activate to ping for 1; gain 1 life; Heliod adds another counter. Infinite damage.
Twin enchanted Exarch can be tapped to make a hasted copy of Exarch, which untaps the original. Infinite hasted creatures.
Animar with 3+ +1/+1 counters lets Ancestral Statue cast for free. Statue bounces itself; recast triggers Animar; loop produces infinite ETB.
Foundry sacrifices Sword to make a thopter token + 1 life; Sword returns when a 1/1 enters. Infinite thopters + infinite life.
Animate Worldgorger; its ETB exiles all permanents including the aura; aura returns; Worldgorger returns with ETB; loop. With Dramatic Reversal effect: infinite ETB.
Mikaeus gives non-human creatures undying. Ballista enters with X+1/+1 counters (via undying), removes counter to ping, dies, returns with another counter via undying. Infinite damage.
With a sac outlet: sac Karmic Guide; Reveillark dies; on Reveillark death, return Karmic + a 2-or-less creature; loop with persist/undying creatures for infinite death triggers.
Sac 5 artifacts to Time Sieve → extra turn. Thopter Assembly: at upkeep with 5 thopters out, bounce Assembly to make 5 thopters. Infinite turns.
Devoted Druid taps for G, untaps with -1/-1 counter. Souleater (or any infect creature) gets infinite +1/+1 via Souleater's ability. Infinite mana + infect.
Saheeli -2 to copy Felidar Guardian; Guardian ETB blinks Saheeli; new Saheeli copies Guardian again. Infinite hasted creatures.
